stripe is 1+1 as a single-node cluster (clusterMode Single): each chunk of a stripe lands on its own device of the one worker, which hands over 2 for data, so the cluster survives 1 device failure but not the loss of the worker; data migration after a device failure runs in relaxed placement on the same node. A cluster meant to grow to more workers is not created as Single and states the stripe of the fleet it will have. A cluster's stripe cannot be changed afterward
enableNodeAffinity is set, because a 1+1 stripe is a mirror and reads are served from the local node's copy first. The control plane takes it at cluster create and never re-applies it, so this is the line to remove now if reads should not prefer the local node
